messages:
Aisha K: FYI Acero just confirmed they want to convert pilot to a subscription commit starting May 1. We need: pricing signoff for a 12-mo term, procurement path (PO vs CC), and seats provisioning timeline. 
Tom S: Awesome — they verbally agreed to 12-mo at the pilot price with a 10% uplift for committed seats. They prefer PO + net30. I'll push for the PO today.
Priya M: Great. If PO + net30, Finance needs the invoice entity and W-9 from Acero. Can we get the legal name and billing address?
Aisha K: Putting customer contact in thread: <mailto:procurement@acero.com|procurement@acero.com>. Legal name is Acero Health, Inc. Billing addr: 220 Harbor Lane, Suite 400, Boston, MA.
Tom S: Sent a note to procurement and asked for a PO template. They said they need our vendor code to complete.
Marta (Finance): Vendor code is RWINF-4421. Also need VAT flag false and billing currency USD. Once PO arrives, finance can generate the invoice within 2 business days.
Priya M: Tagging Jordan for contract/term question — we have the pilot agreement, do we need an amendment or a new contract for the 12-mo subscription?
Jordan (Legal): Amendment is fine for this customer. We should include a clause for seat adjustments and a standard termination notice. I can draft the amendment and share a DocuSign link by EOD if Marta confirms invoicing terms.
Marta (Finance): Confirm net30, USD, vendor code included. We can accept PO scanned + PDF email copy.
Aisha K: Two operational asks: 1) access for 15 additional seats in console (need usernames) and 2) kickoff enablement session for admins week of May 6.
Priya M: I'll collect the 15 usernames from Acero and post them here. Can we provision as provisional seats pending PO?
Tom S: Procurement said they can sign a PO with a scheduled billing start date of May 1 but want the SSO setup before billing.
Marta (Finance): We can set billing start date to May 1 once PO is in. For now finance will place a hold until PO is validated.
Jordan (Legal): Draft ready. Sending to Aisha and Tom for sign-off. Will include standard SLAs and data processing addendum.
Aisha K: Thanks — next actions: Tom to get PO + scanned copy, Priya to gather usernames, Jordan to send DocuSign amendment, Marta to queue invoice. I’ll schedule the enablement session once users are provisioned. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Invoice template RWINF-INV-2026 attached to this thread (internal).
Tom S: PO received (PDF) — uploading now.
Aisha K: Got it. Following up with Acero on SSO metadata. Will update here when enablement meeting is booked.
